subject: FY25 Operating Budget Approval
overview: The School Committee finalized and approved the $77.75 million FY25 operating budget and ratified labor contracts for secretaries and custodians. The committee also authorized a pilot partnership with City Year and adopted a state statute for consolidating school and municipal facilities functions.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: The committee convened in executive session to discuss negotiations with the Medford Educational Secretaries, AFSCME Council 93, and Teamsters Local 25 custodians.

items.title: Ratification of Labor Contracts
items.summary: Approved the ratification of the Medford Educational Secretary’s AFSCME Council 93 contract and the Teamsters Local 25 custodial contract.

items.title: Superintendent Evaluation Goals Update
items.summary: Superintendent Edouard-Vincent reported progress on 2023-2024 goals, including the implementation of a new facility ticketing system, expanded communication translation services, and enhanced ADA accessibility at the high school.

items.title: City Year Pilot Partnership
items.summary: Approved a pilot partnership with City Year to place AmeriCorps members in the Missituk and McGlynn schools to support student learning and increase after-school capacity.

items.title: Operational Infrastructure Contracts
items.summary: Approved five-year contracts for a new Zoom-based VoIP telephone system and a Frontline time reporting system to modernize district payroll and communications.

items.title: School and Municipal Function Consolidation
items.summary: Accepted state statute MGL c. 71, § 37M to allow consolidation of administrative functions with the city, with a requirement that any specific resource-sharing plans return to the committee for approval.

items.title: FY25 Operating Budget
items.summary: Approved the $77.75 million FY25 operating budget, which restores several previously cut positions including literacy coaches and behavioral specialists.

items.title: Supplemental Funding and Substitute Pay Motion
items.summary: Directed Vice Chair Graham to work with the City Financial Task Force to request supplemental funds for substitute pay, kindergarten teachers, and after-school capacity.

items.title: Capital Planning Policy
items.summary: Adopted a new policy establishing seven phases for identifying, prioritizing, and submitting capital improvement projects to the city and Community Preservation Committee.
